description: scipy.integrate.solve_ivp(method='RK45', rtol, atol, t_eval, events): Dormand-Prince 5(4) with the 4th-order dense output and brentq event location

comparison.why: same method, same step-size controller and the same initial-step rule as SciPy RK45, so the number of RHS evaluations and of accepted steps must be identical. The values are not bit-identical because NumPy forms the stage sums and the error estimate with BLAS dot products whose summation order differs; the error estimate is a strongly cancelling sum, so the step sizes differ in the last digits. Gate: |y_rust - y_scipy| <= scipy_gate_units * (atol + rtol*|y_scipy|) at every t_eval point (observed during development: below 0.002 units), the same for event times with |t| in place of |y|; and against the analytic solution |y - y_exact| <= exact_gate_units * (atol + rtol*max|y|), the same bound that SciPy's own solution satisfies (scipy_exact_error_units).
